## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] PowerShell scripts parse.
- [ ] PSScriptAnalyzer reports no errors.
- [ ] Pester tests pass.
- [ ] JSON templates parse.
- [ ] Tenant-specific identifiers and runtime artifacts are absent.
- [ ] Documentation is updated.

## Security and safety

- [ ] No passwords, tokens, device codes, logs, or token caches are included.
- [ ] No real customer or production data is included.
- [ ] Permissions remain delegated and least privilege.
- [ ] Generated behavior remains bounded and reversible.
- [ ] Native UEBA and deterministic detection results are clearly distinguished.

## Manual testing

Describe any disposable-tenant testing and its outcome. Do not paste sensitive
tenant data.
